install.packages("haven")
install.packages("DBI")
install.packages("RSQLite")
install.packages("readr")


library(haven)              #this reads statistical package files like (SPSS, Stata, SAS)
library(DBI)               #and this is for the database
library(RSQLite)          #this is the translator for SQLite databases to make R understand it
library(readr)  

dir.create("data")

students <- data.frame(
student_id = 1:15,
name = c("Alice","Brian","Claire","David","Emma","Felix","Grace","Henry",
              "Irene","James","Karen","Leo","Mary","Nathan","Olivia"),
gender = c("F","M","F","M","F","M","F","M","F","M","F","M","F","M","F"),
class = c("A","A","B","B","A","C","C","A","B","C","A","B","C","B","A"),
math = c(78,65,92,45,81,59,74,88,67,53,95,70,82,38,76),
english = c(85,58,88,52,79,63,90,76,71,49,93,66,87,44,81), 
science = c(72,70,95,48,84,55,68,91,62,58,97,73,80,41,79)
)

head(students)
tail(students)

write.csv(students, "data/student_marks.csv", row.names = FALSE)   #am saving my csv sheet from R

write_sav(students, "data/student_marks.sav") #and here am saving my spss data from R too

write_dta(students, "data/student_marks.dta")  #That's for stata if u want to use it in stata

con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/school.sqlite")

if (dbExistsTable(con, "student_marks")) {
  dbExecute(con, "ALTER TABLE student_marks RENAME TO student_marks_old")
  }          #if the table exists I rename it instead of dropping it

dbExecute(con, "
  CREATE TABLE student_marks (
    student_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name       TEXT,
    gender     TEXT,
    class      TEXT,
    math       INTEGER,
    english    INTEGER,
    science    INTEGER
  )
")

dbAppendTable(con, "student_marks", students)
dbDisconnect(con)

(spss_data <- read_sav("data/student_marks.sav")) 
head(spss_data <- read_sav("data/student_marks.sav"))
str(spss_data)

(stata_data <- read_dta("data/student_marks.dta"))
str(stata_data)

con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "data/school.sqlite")

dbListTables(con)                    
dbListFields(con, "student_marks") 

db_data <- dbReadTable(con, "student_marks")

(top_students <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT name, class, math
  FROM student_marks
  WHERE math > 80
  ORDER BY math DESC
"))

head(db_data)
dbDisconnect(con)

(csv_data <- read.csv("data/student_marks.csv"))
nrow(spss_data)
nrow(stata_data)
nrow(csv_data)
